links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease readability of LLM exercise information for ankylosing spondylitis patients
links.effect: Mean FRE 30.4 ± 14.37 for ChatGPT-4 and 28.77 ± 17.77 for DeepSeek-V3, both classified as very difficult (p > 0.05); college-level comprehension required.
links.quote: Mean FRE scores were 30.4 ± 14.37 for ChatGPT-4 and 28.77 ± 17.77 for DeepSeek-V3, both classified as very difficult (p > 0.05).

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM patient-facing responses relative to patient literacy
links.effect: Both LLMs produced very difficult readability (FRE ~29-30), requiring college-level comprehension, which may reduce accessibility for patients with limited health literacy.
links.quote: However, the complex language used by both LLMs may reduce accessibility for patients with limited health literacy.

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the quality, reliability, usefulness, and readability of responses generated by ChatGPT-4 and DeepSeek-V3 to patient questions on ankylosing spondylitis exercises, but it only benchmarks and compares the models without testing a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
